en.baptism: In the year one thousand nine hundred and six, on the fourteenth day of March, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, Fr. Kuprewicz baptised an infant named Kazimira with all the rites of the Sacrament.
en.parents: Daughter of Frants Frantsev and Kazimira née Gechas, Beliavskii, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on 13 March 1906 in the town of Plungė of this parish.
en.godparents: The godparents were Stanislav Netis and Iustyna Bechos, a maiden.

en.baptism: In the year one thousand nine hundred and six, on the fourteenth day of March, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, Fr. Kuprewicz baptised an infant named Stanislav with all the [rites ...] [text breaks off].
en.parents: Son of Kazimir Simenov and Anna née Budrias, Motunis, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on 11 March 1916 [as drafted] in the village of Kalninikai of this parish.
en.godparents: The godparents were Stanislav L[...]stak and Apolonia, wife of Frants Lastskea.

issues.en: Margin Motunis used; entry text reads Machuitis, which could be a different surname. Birth year 1916 as drafted.
issues.lt: Gimimo metai įskaityti kaip „1916“; pavardė paraštėje (Мотунисовъ) ir tekste („Мачуйтисовъ“) skiriasi; tėvavardis („Сименова“) ir krikštatėvių pavardės neaiškios.
